questions.prompt: Board 9h 8h 7h 6c 2d. You have Th Jd. Villain has Ah 5d. Who wins?

choices.text: You, with a ten-high straight. Villain has no straight or flush.
Villain, because ace high outkicks a straight.
Chop, both play the board straight.

questions.explanation: Th-Jd makes T-9-8-7-6. The ace does not complete a flush or a higher straight.
The higher three of a kind decides. Aces full beats kings full.

questions.prompt: You muck face-down at showdown. Your hand is…

choices.text: Still live if you remember it.
Live if a friend speaks up.
Dead. Mucked cards are not in the showdown.

questions.explanation: A voluntary muck kills the hand. Table it if you want it considered.

questions.prompt: Best five cards: you hold As Kd, board is Ac Ad Kc Kh 4s. You have…
questions.explanation: Three aces and two kings. That is aces full of kings, not four aces.
